notes: Phase 3 Output Contract (Frozen 2026-09-27): (1) Fuel unit is classified as Liters (L) per voyage, Evidence Level B — Strongly Inferred, supported by empirical CO2/fuel ratio (~2.750 kg CO2/L for Marine Diesel, ~2.754 kg CO2/L for HFO), IMO volumetric diesel combustion chemistry, and engine load plausibility. This is an engineering inference, not an explicitly sourced unit. (2) OPEX fuel calculation uses fuel_consumption_L * fuel_price_per_litre_USD_per_L. (3) Operational CII is calculated directly from CO2 mass as (predicted_CO2_kg * 1000) / (dwt_tonnes * distance_nm). (4) Battery end-of-voyage SOC calculations apply predicted SOH to available capacity (effective_ah = pack_capacity_ah * predicted_SOH), so battery degradation directly affects reported end-of-voyage SOC. (5) predicted_SOH is also exported separately for long-term health and lifecycle tracking.
